name: Sun Cleric: Solar Conduit already boosts Dawn's own embedded Dawnsear cast-time cut (#1562)
contract: Dawn (807440) already carries, on its own effect index 1, an ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108) with MiscValue 10 = SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME and EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 0x2, which Dawnsear (500146) matches in its own SpellFamilyFlags word 1 (0x2) via the generic family-33 flag96 AND. That embedded modifier's own BasePoints (-1) resolves to 0 (a deliberate no-op baseline) while Dawn's aura is present but nothing has boosted it. Solar Conduit (300321) is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), MiscValue 12 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (Blizzard's 1-based 'Effect2' name for zero-based effect index 1), EffectSpellClassMask word 0 = 0x40, matching Dawn's own SpellFamilyFlags word 0 (0x40) -- so Solar Conduit's flat modifier raises effect index 1's stored value on Dawn itself (SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue -> Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers applies SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 for index 1) from 0 to -20 (BasePoints -21 resolves to -20) precisely while Dawn's own aura is present, i.e. 'while Dawn is active'. That -20 is then what Dawn's own effect hands to Dawnsear's cast time. This is a two-level native SpellMod chain, both links independently confirmed by classMask/family-flag overlap; no server code needed.

steps.label: Dawn's own embedded modifier is a no-op with nothing to boost it
Dawnsear cast time before Dawn or the talent
Reduces the cast time of Dawnsear by 20% while Dawn is active
Learning the talent alone changes nothing while Dawn is not up
Solar Conduit now boosts Dawn's own embedded modifier to -20
Dawnsear now casts at 80% of its base cast time (20% faster) while Dawn is active
